2. If someone is kind then they are green. (Kind -> green)
3. Young people are kind. (Young -> kind)
4. If someone is furry and kind then they are round. (Furry & kind -> round)
5. If someone is round and rough then they are young. (Round & rough -> young)
6. If someone is green then they are smart. (Green -> smart)

Goal: Harry is smart.

We have Harry is rough (fact) and Harry is young (fact). Need to see if we can derive smart.

From young -> kind (rule 3): Since Harry is young, we can derive Harry is kind.

Now we have Harry kind, Harry rough.

From kind -> green (rule 2): Harry kind => Harry is green.

From green -> smart (rule 6): Harry green => Harry is smart.

Thus we can derive Harry is smart.

Thus answer True.
